full_output.paper_title: The recA operon: A novel stress response gene cluster in Bacteroides fragilis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the bcp gene in Bacteroides fragilis, which encodes a bacterioferritin co-migratory protein (BCP) with antioxidant properties, providing protection against oxidative stress.
full_output.methodology: Quantitative RT-PCR, heterologous expression, and biochemical assays were used to characterize the BCP protein's function.

full_output.paper_title: Charge counter charge: bacterial response to antimicrobial cationic peptides and more.

confers_resistance_to: polypeptides of the defensin and protegrin families
mprF.role_in_paper: The gene mprF (multi peptide resistance factor), which encodes aminoacyl-PG synthase, was discovered by screening a transposon insertion library of Staphylococcus xylosus C2a for sensitivity to the lantibiotic gallidermin, a polypeptide antibiotic.
mprF.validation_method: The resistance conferred by MprF to the α-defensins HNP-1 and -2, were moderate and also concentration-dependent. These authors also reported that infection with an mprF mutant produced fewer bacteria after 1–2 h of infection than the wild type in Caco-2 epithelial cells, HeLa cells and the P388D1 macrophage cell line. In a mouse model of infection, growth of the mutant in the spleen was attenuated and even more so in the liver.
mprF.source: The gene mprF (multi peptide resistance factor), which encodes aminoacyl-PG synthase, was discovered by screening a transposon insertion library of Staphylococcus xylosus C2a for sensitivity to the lantibiotic gallidermin, a polypeptide antibiotic.
mprF.evidence_note: The presence of MprF (aa-PG synthase) in L. monocytogenes did confer resistance to two aminoglycosides, tobramycin and geneticin, but no effect of this mutation on resistance to these compounds was observed in the case of B. subtilis.

full_output.key_findings: The mprF gene in Listeria monocytogenes encodes an aminoacyl-PG synthase that confers resistance to cationic antimicrobial peptides and certain aminoglycosides. Mutations in mprF lead to increased sensitivity to these agents and affect osmotic stress resistance and motility.
full_output.methodology: Genetic analysis and susceptibility testing of mprF mutants in L. monocytogenes.

full_output.paper_title: Insects represent a link between food animal farms and the urban environment for antibiotic resistance traits.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the role of insects, such as houseflies and cockroaches, in transmitting antibiotic-resistant bacteria between food animal farms and urban environments. It discusses the presence of multidrug-resistant enterococci and other bacteria in insects, emphasizing their potential to spread antibiotic resistance traits.
full_output.methodology: The study reviews existing literature and reports on the detection of antibiotic-resistant bacteria in insects collected from various environments, including farms and urban areas.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of novel regulatory small RNAs in Acinetobacter baumannii.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies three novel small RNAs (AbsR11, AbsR25, and AbsR28) in Acinetobacter baumannii, which are involved in regulating gene expression under stress conditions.
full_output.methodology: Bioinformatic prediction combined with experimental validation using Northern blotting and RACE mapping.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of an automated rapid diagnostic assay for detection of Gram-negative bacteria and their drug-resistance genes in positive blood cultures.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the Verigene BC-GN assay for rapid detection of Gram-negative bacteria and their drug-resistance genes in positive blood cultures. It successfully detected 9 bacterial species and 9 drug resistance genes, including bla CTX-M, bla IMP, bla KPC, bla NDM, bla OXA-23, bla OXA-24/40, bla OXA-48, bla OXA-58, and bla VIM.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR, DNA sequencing, and the Verigene BC-GN assay to detect and characterize drug resistance genes in bacterial isolates from blood cultures.

full_output.paper_title: Flavone-resistant Leishmania donovani overexpresses LdMRP2 transporter in the parasite and activates host MRP2 on macrophages to circumvent the flavone-mediated cell death.

LdMRP2.validation_method: overexpression in parasites and measurement of drug efflux

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies LdABCC2 as a transporter responsible for baicalein resistance in Leishmania donovani, demonstrating its role in drug efflux and resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: Overexpression, efflux assays, and gene expression analysis were used to validate the role of LdABCC2 in baicalein resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Global dissemination of a multidrug resistant Escherichia coli clone.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the CTX-M-15 extended-spectrum beta-lactamase, fimH30 fimbrial adhesin, and mutations in gyrA and parC as key contributors to multidrug resistance in Escherichia coli ST131.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and comparative genomic analysis of 95 E. coli ST131 strains from six geographical regions.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance pattern and their beta-lactamase encoding genes among Pseudomonas aeruginosa strains isolated from cancer patients.

blaVIM-2.evidence_note: The paper states that blaVIM-2 was detected in 58.3% of imipenem-resistant isolates and that all ESBL-producing P. aeruginosa were resistant to ceftazidime.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaVIM-2, blaOXA-10, blaVEB-1, blaNDM, and blaIMP-1 as the most prevalent beta-lactamase genes in P. aeruginosa isolates from Egypt, contributing to resistance against imipenem and ceftazidime.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR, and phenotypic detection methods were used to identify and characterize beta-lactamase genes in P. aeruginosa isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Carbapenemase genes among multidrug resistant gram negative clinical isolates from a tertiary hospital in Mwanza, Tanzania.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of carbapenemase genes, including blaIMP, blaVIM, blaKPC, blaOXA-48, and blaNDM, among multidrug resistant gram-negative bacteria in Tanzania.
full_output.methodology: PCR assays were used to detect carbapenemase genes in 227 MDR-GNB isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Perfrin, a novel bacteriocin associated with netB positive Clostridium perfringens strains from broilers with necrotic enteritis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies perfrin, a novel bacteriocin produced by netB-positive Clostridium perfringens strains associated with necrotic enteritis in broilers. Perfrin exhibits antimicrobial activity against other C. perfringens strains but not against its producer strain.
full_output.methodology: The study involved purification, characterization, and cloning of perfrin, along with PCR detection and antimicrobial activity assays.
full_output.sample_size: 50 poultry-derived C. perfringens strains and 45 non-poultry-derived strains

full_output.paper_title: Rapid optical determination of β-lactamase and antibiotic activity.
full_output.key_findings: The study introduces a rapid optical method called β-LEAF to detect β-lactamase production and assess the activity of β-lactam antibiotics, demonstrating its consistency with traditional methods.
full_output.methodology: The β-LEAF assay uses a fluorescent probe to detect β-lactamase activity through fluorescence quenching, validated against standard methods like nitrocefin disk tests and disk diffusion.

full_output.paper_title: Isolation and characterization of multiple drug resistance bacterial pathogens from waste water in hospital and non-hospital environments, Northwest Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of multiple drug resistance (MDR) among bacterial isolates from hospital and non-hospital wastewater in Northwest Ethiopia, with Klebsiella spp., Pseudomonas spp., E. coli, and Citrobacter spp. showing high resistance to various antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Bacterial isolates were obtained from wastewater samples and tested for antimicrobial susceptibility using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Virulence factors, serogroups and antimicrobial resistance properties of Escherichia coli strains in fermented dairy products.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several antimicrobial resistance genes in Escherichia coli strains isolated from fermented dairy products, including aadA1, tetA, tetB, blaSHV, CITM, and aac(3)-IV, which conferred resistance to streptomycin, tetracycline, cephalothin, ampicillin, and gentamicin.
full_output.methodology: PCR and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize antimicrobial resistance genes in E. coli strains.

full_output.paper_title: Predominance of multi-resistant gram-negative bacteria colonizing chronic lower limb ulcers (CLLUs) at Bugando Medical Center.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports a high prevalence of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing gram-negative bacteria and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) in chronic lower limb ulcers at Bugando Medical Center, highlighting the need for improved infection control and antibiotic stewardship.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed 300 wound swabs using standard microbiological techniques and antimicrobial susceptibility testing via the Kirby-Bauer method.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of the type 2 NADH:menaquinone oxidoreductases from Staphylococcus aureus and the bactericidal action of phenothiazines.

ndhF.validation_method: expression and purification of the protein, enzymatic activity assays

ndhC.validation_method: expression and purification of the protein, enzymatic activity assays

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes two type 2 NADH:menaquinone oxidoreductases, ndhF and ndhC, from Staphylococcus aureus. These enzymes play a role in the respiratory chain and are targeted by phenothiazines, which inhibit their activity and affect membrane potential and ATP levels.
full_output.methodology: Gene cloning, protein expression and purification, enzymatic activity assays, and membrane potential measurements.

full_output.paper_title: Heterologous expression of thuricin CD immunity genes in Listeria monocytogenes.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies trnI as a gene encoding a small immunity protein that provides protection against thuricin CD in Listeria monocytogenes. Additionally, trnF and trnG are part of a functional ABC transporter system contributing to thuricin CD immunity.
full_output.methodology: Heterologous expression of genes in Listeria monocytogenes followed by MIC assays and time-kill studies.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular and epidemiological characterization of IMP-type metallo-β-lactamase-producing Enterobacter cloacae in a Large tertiary care hospital in Japan.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies blaIMP as a gene conferring resistance to carbapenems in IMP-type metallo-beta-lactamase-producing Enterobacter cloacae.
full_output.methodology: PCR, immunochromatographic assay, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Bactericidal activity of the human skin fatty acid cis-6-hexadecanoic acid on Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the bactericidal effects of cis-6-hexadecanoic acid (C6H) on Staphylococcus aureus, demonstrating its ability to disrupt membrane integrity, alter membrane potential, and interfere with cellular processes such as ATP production and electron transport.
full_output.methodology: The study employed a variety of biochemical and microbiological techniques, including membrane integrity assays, ATP measurements, electron transport chain analysis, and fluorescence microscopy, to investigate the mechanisms of C6H-induced bactericidal activity.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characterization and antimicrobial susceptibility of Streptococcus pneumoniae isolated from children hospitalized with respiratory infections in Suzhou, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of antimicrobial resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates from children in Suzhou, China, with a focus on macrolide resistance genes ermB and mefA/E. The Taiwan 19F-14 clones were found to be particularly resistant to β-lactams and carried both ermB and mefA/E genes.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of resistance genes, antimicrobial susceptibility testing via E-test, and MLST for molecular typing.

full_output.paper_title: The Effect of New Zealand Manuka-Type Honeys on Staphylococcus aureus Biofilms
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that New Zealand manuka-type honeys effectively inhibit and eliminate Staphylococcus aureus biofilms, with manuka honey being the most effective. The research also indicates that planktonic cells released from biofilms after honey treatment do not develop resistance to honey.
full_output.methodology: Biofilm formation and viability assays, crystal violet staining, ATP viability kit, and confocal laser scanning microscopy were used to evaluate the effects of honeys on S. aureus biofilms.
full_output.sample_size: Various S. aureus strains including NCTC 8325, ATCC 25923, MW2, and USA300

full_output.paper_title: Gyramides prevent bacterial growth by inhibiting DNA gyrase and altering chromosome topology.

gyrA.notes: Mutations in gyrA confer reduced susceptibility to compound 3.

gyrB.notes: Mutations in gyrB confer reduced susceptibility to compound 3.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in gyrA and gyrB that confer reduced susceptibility to gyramide 3, highlighting the importance of these genes in the resistance mechanism against this novel gyrase inhibitor.
full_output.methodology: The study used spontaneous mutant analysis to identify mutations in gyrA and gyrB that confer reduced susceptibility to gyramide 3.

full_output.paper_title: Novel determinants of antibiotic resistance: identification of mutated loci in highly methicillin-resistant subpopulations of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

SACOL1745.encodes: Ribosome binding site of pyruvate kinase (pyk)

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in 27 genes and 3 intergenic sequences in highly resistant subpopulations of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) that contribute to high-level β-lactam resistance. These mutations are associated with the induction of a stringent stress response, which enhances the expression of the resistance protein PBP2A.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing of highly resistant (H*R) isolates and their corresponding parental strains to identify mutated loci associated with β-lactam resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Real-Time PCR detection and quantitation of Helicobacter pylori clarithromycin-resistant strains in archival material and correlation with Sydney classification.

23S rRNA.notes: Mutations in the 23S rRNA gene were identified as the main cause of clarithromycin resistance in H. pylori.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified point mutations in the 23S rRNA gene of Helicobacter pylori that confer resistance to clarithromycin, particularly A→G transitions at positions 2142 and 2143, and an A→C transition at position 2142. These mutations were associated with increased resistance and correlated with histological features of gastritis.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized RT-PCR and melting curve analysis to detect mutations in the 23S rRNA gene of H. pylori, along with Q-RT-PCR for quantitating bacterial density.

full_output.paper_title: Laminaria japonica Extract, an Inhibitor of Clavibater michiganense Subsp. Sepedonicum.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies Fractionation three (Fr.3) from Laminaria japonica as having potent antimicrobial activity against Clavibater michiganense subsp. sepedonicum, with a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of 0.04 mg/mL. Fr.3 was found to disrupt cell walls and membranes, induce reactive oxygen species, alter calcium levels, and inhibit metabolic pathways.
full_output.methodology: The study used agar diffusion, GC-MS, and microscopic techniques to analyze the antimicrobial properties of L. japonica extracts.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that environmental parameters such as pH, temperature, and osmotic pressure significantly affect the antibiotic resistance, cell morphology, and membrane fatty acid composition of Staphylococcus lugdunensis. Specifically, increased osmotic stress (5% NaCl) led to higher antibiotic resistance, particularly to gentamicin.
full_output.methodology: The study examined the effects of varying environmental conditions on S. lugdunensis by growing cultures under controlled pH, temperature, and osmotic pressure conditions, followed by assessment of antibiotic resistance, cell size, and membrane fatty acid composition.

full_output.key_findings: The paper reviews the pharmacokinetics, safety, and efficacy of several antibiotics used to treat MRSA infections in infants, children, and adults, focusing on linezolid, daptomycin, quinupristin/dalfopristin, telavancin, and ceftaroline.
full_output.methodology: Review of existing literature and clinical trials on the pharmacokinetics and safety profiles of antibiotics for MRSA infections.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular recognition and modification of the 30S ribosome by the aminoglycoside-resistance methyltransferase NpmA.

npmA.mechanism: modifies the 16S rRNA at position A1408 by adding a methyl group, preventing aminoglycoside antibiotics from binding to the ribosome
npmA.validation_method: structural studies, biochemical assays, and functional tests

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the aminoglycoside-resistance methyltransferase NpmA, which modifies the 16S rRNA at position A1408, thereby conferring resistance to kanamycin. The structural and functional analysis of NpmA provides insight into the molecular mechanism of resistance.
full_output.methodology: X-ray crystallography, biochemical assays, and mutagenesis studies were used to analyze the structure and function of NpmA.

parC.notes: The S79Y mutation in parC was identified in quinolone-resistant mutants.

full_output.key_findings: Fluoroquinolone resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae is primarily due to mutations in the parC gene, particularly the S79Y mutation. Prophage induction by fluoroquinolones leads to lysis of lysogenic strains, reducing the likelihood of resistance development in these isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR, Southern blot hybridization, sequencing of parC QRDR regions, and growth kinetics analysis.

embB.validation_method: microarray analysis

full_output.key_findings: The study presents a simplified microarray system for detecting resistance markers in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, focusing on mutations in rpoB, katG, inhA, embB, and rpsL associated with resistance to rifampin, isoniazid, ethambutol, and streptomycin.
full_output.methodology: The microarray system was validated through comparative analysis with phenotypic drug susceptibility testing and DNA sequencing.

full_output.paper_title: The detection and verification of carbapenemases using ertapenem and Matrix Assisted Laser Desorption Ionization-Time of Flight.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents a rapid method for detecting and verifying KPC, VIM, and NDM carbapenemases in Klebsiella pneumoniae and Pseudomonas aeruginosa using ertapenem and MALDI-TOF MS. The method successfully identified KPC, VIM, and NDM producers, although some VIM-producing P. aeruginosa isolates were not detected within the 120-minute timeframe.
full_output.methodology: Hydrolysis assay with ertapenem and MALDI-TOF MS analysis to detect carbapenemase production.
full_output.sample_size: 17 clinical isolates of K. pneumoniae and 11 clinical isolates of P. aeruginosa

full_output.paper_title: Ras GTPase-like protein MglA, a controller of bacterial social-motility in Myxobacteria, has evolved to control bacterial predation by Bdellovibrio.

bd2494.encodes: transmembrane protein with a DUF490 domain
bd2494.mechanism: part of a TamAB-like transporter complex

bd2495.mechanism: part of a TamAB-like transporter complex

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies MglA and Bd2492 as essential for predatory invasion by Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus, with MglA regulating pilus formation and Bd2492 interacting with MglA to facilitate prey-invasion.
full_output.methodology: Genetic deletion experiments, co-purification assays, and bacterial two-hybrid analysis were used to determine the roles of MglA and Bd2492 in Bdellovibrio predation.

full_output.paper_title: Novel rearrangements in the staphylococcal cassette chromosome mec type V elements of Indian ST772 and ST672 methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus strains.

mecA.mechanism: confers resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics by reducing affinity
mecA.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and comparison with reference strains

ccrC1.mechanism: mediates integration and excision of SCC mec elements
ccrC1.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and comparison with reference strains

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes novel rearrangements in SCC mec type V elements of Indian ST772 and ST672 methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus strains, highlighting the presence of mecA and ccrC1 genes involved in beta-lactam resistance and SCC mec element mobility.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing of seven ST772 and one ST672 S. aureus isolates followed by comparative analysis with reference strains.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance of Salmonella enterica Isolates from Tonsil and Jejunum with Lymph Node Tissues of Slaughtered Swine in Metro Manila, Philippines.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug-resistant (MDR) Salmonella enterica isolates from swine in the Philippines, with particular emphasis on tigecycline resistance in S. enterica serotype Enteritidis. High resistance rates were observed to several antibiotics, including amikacin, cefazolin, cefuroxime, cefoxitin, and gentamicin.
full_output.methodology: VITEK 2 antimicrobial susceptibility testing was used to analyze 20 S. enterica isolates from swine tissues.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of carbapenemase-producing enterobacteriaceae in the baltic countries and st. Petersburg area.

blaNDM.evidence_note: The paper states that 15 K. pneumoniae strains hydrolyzed ertapenem and carried the bla NDM gene.

full_output.key_findings: The study detected blaNDM genes in 15 carbapenem-nonsusceptible K. pneumoniae strains from a hospital in St. Petersburg, Russia, indicating the presence of NDM-type carbapenemase-producing bacteria in the region.
full_output.methodology: Real-time PCR and MALDI-TOF MS were used for detection and characterization of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacteriaceae.

full_output.paper_title: Pyrosequencing for rapid detection of tuberculosis resistance in clinical isolates and sputum samples from re-treatment pulmonary tuberculosis patients.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a pyrosequencing method for the rapid detection of resistance to rifampin, isoniazid, ethambutol, streptomycin, ofloxacin, and amikacin in Mycobacterium tuberculosis clinical isolates and sputum samples from re-treatment pulmonary tuberculosis patients.
full_output.methodology: Pyrosequencing was used to detect mutations in the rpoB, katG, embB, rrs, gyrA, and rpsl genes associated with drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

full_output.paper_title: Chemical composition, antimicrobial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and a pro-apoptotic effect in SGC-7901 of the essential oil from Toona sinensis (A. Juss.) Roem. leaves.
full_output.key_findings: The essential oil from Toona sinensis leaves (TSL-EO) showed antimicrobial activity against Staphylococcus aureus, including both methicillin-sensitive and methicillin-resistant strains, with low minimum inhibitory concentrations. Additionally, TSL-EO exhibited significant cytotoxicity and pro-apoptotic effects in SGC-7901 cancer cells.
full_output.methodology: GC/MS analysis, broth dilution method for MIC determination, MTT assay for cytotoxicity, Hoechst 33324 staining, and flow cytometry for apoptosis detection.
full_output.sample_size: 20 clinically isolated strains of Staphylococcus aureus, 2 standard strains, and 3 cancer cell lines

full_output.paper_title: Linsitinib (OSI-906) antagonizes ATP-binding cassette subfamily G member 2 and subfamily C member 10-mediated drug resistance.

ABCG2.validation_method: cytotoxicity assays, drug accumulation and efflux studies

ABCC10.validation_method: cytotoxicity assays, drug accumulation and efflux studies

full_output.key_findings: Linsitinib reverses ABCG2- and ABCC10-mediated multidrug resistance by inhibiting their efflux functions without altering protein expression levels.
full_output.methodology: Cytotoxicity assays, drug accumulation and efflux studies, immunoblotting, and immunofluorescence assays.

full_output.paper_title: Impact of UV and peracetic acid disinfection on the prevalence of virulence and antimicrobial resistance genes in uropathogenic Escherichia coli in wastewater effluents.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that UV and PAA disinfection reduced the proportion of UPECs and that PAA also reduced the proportion of antimicrobial resistance gene-carrying UPEC pathotypes in municipal wastewaters.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR/Bioplex screening and DNA microarray hybridization to analyze the prevalence of virulence and antimicrobial resistance genes in E. coli isolates from wastewater effluents.

full_output.paper_title: Inhibition and biochemical characterization of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus shikimate dehydrogenase: an in silico and kinetic study.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterized the shikimate dehydrogenase (SaSDH) from methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and identified three small molecule inhibitors (compounds 238, 766, and 894) that show significant inhibition of SaSDH activity.
full_output.methodology: Biochemical characterization, homology modeling, virtual screening, and kinetic studies were conducted to analyze SaSDH and identify potential inhibitors.

23S rRNA.evidence_note: The G2073A mutation in 23S rRNA was identified in all resistant mutants examined, which showed resistance to both chloramphenicol and florfenicol. Additionally, the mutants exhibited reduced susceptibility to erythromycin, suggesting cross-resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a novel G2073A mutation in the 23S rRNA gene of Campylobacter jejuni that is associated with resistance to chloramphenicol, florfenicol, and erythromycin. Additionally, a G74D mutation in the L4 ribosomal protein was found to confer low-level erythromycin resistance in chloramphenicol-selected mutants.
full_output.methodology: In vitro selection of resistant strains, sequencing of 23S rRNA, L4, and L22 genes, and MIC testing.

full_output.paper_title: Ribosomal protein S29 regulates metabolic insecticide resistance through binding and degradation of CYP6N3.
full_output.key_findings: CYP6N3, a CYP450 enzyme, interacts with RPS29 and is degraded by the proteasome, contributing to deltamethrin resistance in mosquito cells. RPS29 overexpression targets CYP6N3 for proteasomal degradation, reducing resistance.
full_output.methodology: Tandem affinity purification, GST pull-down, immunofluorescence, confocal microscopy, FRET, cell viability assay, Western blotting, real-time PCR.

full_output.paper_title: Inactivation of the antibacterial and cytotoxic properties of silver ions by biologically relevant compounds.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that biologically relevant compounds such as glutathione, cysteine, and human blood components significantly reduce the toxicity of silver ions to clinically relevant pathogenic bacteria and human dermal fibroblasts.
full_output.methodology: The study used microbiological assays, cytotoxicity tests, and ICP-OES to analyze the effects of silver ions and thiol-containing compounds on bacterial growth and human cell viability.

full_output.paper_title: Abattoirs as non-hospital source of extended spectrum beta lactamase producers: confirmed by the double disc synergy test and characterized by matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time of flight mass spectrometry.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified ESBL-producing organisms in abattoirs, highlighting their potential as a source of human infection. It found that the resistance markers were chromosomally borne rather than plasmid-mediated.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic confirmation of ESBL production via DDST and characterization using MALDI-TOF MS.

23S rRNA.notes: Mutations in region V of the 23S rRNA gene were associated with macrolide resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified macrolide resistance in Mycoplasma genitalium isolates, with mutations in region V of the 23S rRNA gene being the primary mechanism.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective survey of M. genitalium testing and pyrosequencing for macrolide resistance mutations.

full_output.paper_title: QnrS1 structure-activity relationships.

qnrS1.mechanism: protects DNA gyrase from quinolone inhibition
qnrS1.validation_method: expression in E. coli BL21(DE3) and measurement of ciprofloxacin MICs

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the role of QnrS1 loop B in conferring ciprofloxacin resistance and protecting DNA gyrase from quinolone inhibition. Specific amino acid substitutions in loop B were shown to affect resistance levels and gyrase protection.
full_output.methodology: Expression of wild-type and mutated QnrS1 in E. coli BL21(DE3), determination of ciprofloxacin MICs, and analysis of gyrase protection assays.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that all Vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium (VREF) isolates were susceptible to linezolid, daptomycin, and quinupristin-dalfopristin, with linezolid being the only antimicrobial agent with in vitro activity against VREF that was administered to the cohort.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study evaluating patients with VREF bacteremia, including antibiotic susceptibility testing using Etest and statistical analysis of mortality factors.

full_output.paper_title: MUBII-TB-DB: a database of mutations associated with antibiotic resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: The MUBII-TB-DB database compiles mutations in seven Mycobacterium tuberculosis genes associated with resistance to first-line and second-line antibiotics, including rpoB, katG, pncA, rrs, gyrA, and gyrB.
full_output.methodology: Systematic review of literature and database construction for mutation analysis in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

full_output.paper_title: Double mutation of cell wall proteins CspB and Pbp1a increases secretion of the antibody Fab fragment from Corynebacterium glutamicum.

mutations_found.validated_by: growth assay in LB liquid medium

pbp1a.notes: Mutation in pbp1a affects cell surface integrity

mutations_found.validated_by: growth assay in LB liquid medium

cspB.notes: Mutation in cspB affects cell surface integrity

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that deletions of cspB and pbp1a genes significantly enhance the secretion of the antibody Fab fragment from Corynebacterium glutamicum, indicating that these genes are involved in cell wall permeability barriers.
full_output.methodology: The study used genetic modifications, growth assays, and protein analysis techniques to evaluate the impact of gene deletions on Fab secretion.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial susceptibility pattern of bacterial isolates from wound infection and their sensitivity to alternative topical agents at Jimma University Specialized Hospital, South-West Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study found high levels of antimicrobial resistance among bacterial isolates from wound infections, particularly to ampicillin, penicillin, cephalothin, and tetracycline. Acetic acid (0.5%), dabkin solution (1%) and 3% hydrogen peroxide were bactericidal to all isolated bacteria.
full_output.methodology: The study conducted antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method and determined minimum inhibitory and bactericidal concentrations using the tube dilution method.

full_output.paper_title: Pharmacodynamic profiling of commonly prescribed antimicrobial drugs against Escherichia coli isolates from urinary tract.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the pharmacodynamic profiles of five antimicrobials against E. coli isolates from urinary tract infections, highlighting the susceptibility of isolates to carbapenems and the reduced effectiveness of ciprofloxacin and ceftriaxone in certain scenarios.
full_output.methodology: The study used Etest for MIC determination and Monte Carlo simulation to assess pharmacodynamic exposure.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes and mutations in Salmonella enterica serotype Heidelberg isolates, including bla, aac(6')-Ib, tet(M), qnrS1, and erm(B). Mutations in genes such as SEEHRA37_03221, SEEHRA37_24108, and others were associated with resistance traits.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify AMR genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and molecular characteristics of drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis in Hunan, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various mutations associated with drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from Hunan, China, including katG 315, inhA15, rpoB 531, rpoB 526, rpoB 516, rpsL 43, rrs 514, embB 306, pncA 96, rrs 1401, gyrA 94, and gyrA 90.
full_output.methodology: DNA sequencing and drug susceptibility testing were used to identify mutations and resistance patterns in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the effects of Staphylococcus aureus alpha-toxin (Hla) on the metabolome of human airway epithelial cells, revealing cell-specific changes in metabolite concentrations and metabolic pathways.
full_output.methodology: The study used 1H-NMR, GC-MS, and HPLC-MS to analyze intracellular and extracellular metabolites in response to Hla treatment.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of Integrase Gene in E. coli Isolated from Pigs at Different Stages of Production System.

Int1.mechanism: capture, integrate, and mobilize antibiotic resistance gene cassettes

Int2.mechanism: capture, integrate, and mobilize antibiotic resistance gene cassettes

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of integron class 1 (Int1) and integron class 2 (Int2) in commensal E. coli strains isolated from pigs at various stages of production and from the farm environment, indicating their potential role in the spread of antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of integron classes 1 and 2 in E. coli isolates from pigs and environmental samples.

full_output.paper_title: Escherichia coli Strains Isolated from the Uteri Horn, Mouth, and Rectum of Bitches Suffering from Pyometra: Virulence Factors, Antimicrobial Susceptibilities, and Clonal Relationships among Strains.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified antimicrobial resistance patterns in E. coli isolates from bitches with pyometra, highlighting resistance to cephalothin, ampicillin, and nalidixic acid. It also noted the presence of various virulence factors but did not characterize any specific AMR genes or mutations.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR for virulence genes, and genotyping methods including REP, ERIC, and BOX-PCR.
full_output.sample_size: 70 E. coli isolates from pyometra bitches and 43 from healthy bitches

mutations_found.validated_by: transduction of mutated gyrB gene into strain HG001 resulting in strain HG001 nov142

gyrB.notes: Wild-type gyrB is susceptible to aminocoumarins

full_output.paper_title: A trisubstituted benzimidazole cell division inhibitor with efficacy against Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies SB-P17G-A20 as a potent trisubstituted benzimidazole cell division inhibitor targeting FtsZ in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, showing efficacy against clinical isolates and reducing bacterial load in a murine model of infection.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized in vitro growth assays, TEM analysis, plasma stability studies, and a murine model of infection to evaluate the efficacy and mechanism of action of SB-P17G-A20.

full_output.paper_title: Anthracimycin activity against contemporary methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.key_findings: Anthracimycin shows potent activity against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and other Gram-positive bacteria, with MIC values < 0.25 mg/L. It exhibits rapid bactericidal activity and can protect mice from MRSA-induced mortality.
full_output.methodology: MIC assays, time-kill kinetics, mechanism of action studies, and mouse infection models were used to evaluate anthracimycin's activity.

full_output.paper_title: Efficacy of novel antibacterial compounds targeting histidine kinase YycG protein.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated six derivatives of compound 2 targeting the histidine kinase YycG protein, showing antibacterial and antibiofilm activities against Staphylococcus epidermidis and Staphylococcus aureus. These derivatives exhibited lower MIC values and improved antibiofilm properties compared to the prototype compound 2.
full_output.methodology: The study used broth dilution methods, Kinase-Glo luminescent kinase assays, and in vivo rabbit subcutaneous biofilm infection models to assess the antibacterial and antibiofilm activities of the derivatives.

full_output.paper_title: A systematic follow-up of Mycobacterium tuberculosis drug-resistance and associated genotypic lineages in the French Departments of the Americas over a seventeen-year period.

rpoB.notes: Mutation detected in 5 MDR strains.

katG.notes: Mutation detected in 5 MDR strains.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified specific mutations in the rpoB and katG genes associated with rifampicin and isoniazid resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from the French Departments of the Americas.
full_output.methodology: Drug susceptibility testing, spoligotyping, and MIRU-VNTR analysis were used to determine resistance profiles and genotypic lineages of M. tuberculosis isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Transferable vancomycin resistance in a community-associated MRSA lineage.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the emergence of vancomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (VRSA) in a community-associated MRSA lineage, highlighting the transfer of the vanA gene cluster via a novel plasmid, pBRZ01, which also carries aac(6')-aph(2"), conferring resistance to vancomycin and gentamicin, respectively.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, plasmid characterization, and filter mating experiments were conducted to analyze the transferability and resistance mechanisms of the vanA gene cluster in the VRSA strain.

full_output.paper_title: Integrative analyses of genetic variation, epigenetic regulation, and the transcriptome to elucidate the biology of platinum sensitivity.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies ABCD2 and miR-30d as key players in platinum sensitivity, with ABCD2 knockdown leading to increased cisplatin-induced apoptosis and miR-30d over-expression decreasing ABCD2 expression.
full_output.methodology: Genome-wide integrative pyramid analysis combined with functional validation experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Rational design of broad spectrum antibacterial activity based on a clinically relevant enoyl-acyl carrier protein (ACP) reductase inhibitor.

fabI.notes: Mutations in fabI gene were selected during resistance experiments against PT166.

full_output.key_findings: The study focused on the development of a novel FabI inhibitor, PT166, which showed extended antimicrobial activity against various pathogens, including E. coli, F. tularensis, Proteus mirabilis, and M. tuberculosis, while maintaining in vivo efficacy and favorable pharmacokinetics.
full_output.methodology: The research involved structural biology techniques, including X-ray crystallography, kinetic studies, and computational modeling to understand the molecular basis of FabI inhibition and optimize inhibitor design.

full_output.paper_title: Haemophilus influenzae porine ompP2 gene transfer mediated by graphene oxide nanoparticles with effects on transformation process and virulence bacterial capacity.
full_output.key_findings: The ompP2 gene from a chloramphenicol-resistant H. influenzae strain was transferred using graphene oxide nanoparticles, leading to increased chloramphenicol resistance and adhesion to human cell lines.
full_output.methodology: Gene transfer via graphene oxide nanoparticles, transformation assays, and adhesion tests on human cell lines.

full_output.paper_title: Outbreak of Clostridium difficile PCR ribotype 027--the recent experience of a regional hospital.

tcdC.notes: The 18-bp deletion in the tcdC gene leads to increased toxin production.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the presence of the C. difficile PCR ribotype 027 strain, which exhibits a 18-bp deletion in the tcdC gene and carries the binary toxin genes cdtA and cdtB. This strain shows reduced susceptibility to moxifloxacin.
full_output.methodology: PCR ribotyping, PCR detection of toxin genes, and E-test for moxifloxacin susceptibility.

full_output.paper_title: Chemical modulation of the biological activity of reutericyclin: a membrane-active antibiotic from Lactobacillus reuteri.
full_output.key_findings: The study explored the structure-activity relationships of reutericyclin, a membrane-active antibiotic from Lactobacillus reuteri, by synthesizing various analogs and evaluating their antibacterial activity against Gram-positive pathogens. Key findings indicate that lipophilic substituents enhance activity, while polar groups diminish it. Compounds like 5, 7, and 13 showed excellent activity against most tested Gram-positive pathogens.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis of reutericyclin analogs, determination of minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs), cytotoxicity assays, and evaluation of membrane potential disruption.

full_output.paper_title: Profiling of rpoB mutations and MICs for rifampin and rifabutin in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

rpoB.notes: mutations in rpoB are associated with resistance to rifampin and rifabutin

full_output.paper_title: MZC is stable and safe
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the stability, safety, and antiviral activity of MZC, demonstrating its effectiveness against HIV, SHIV-RT, HSV-2, and HPV-16 PsV in various animal models.
full_output.methodology: The study conducted in vitro and in vivo experiments, including antiviral activity assays, pharmacokinetic studies, and animal challenge models to assess the efficacy and safety of MZC.

full_output.paper_title: Phenotypic and molecular characterization of multidrug resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolated from a university teaching hospital, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple AMR genes in multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, including bla TEM, bla CTX-M, bla DHA, and bla KPC, which contribute to resistance against various antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification and sequencing analysis were used to detect AMR genes in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Class 1 integrons and antibiotic resistance of clinical Acinetobacter calcoaceticus-baumannii complex in Poznań, Poland.

aadA1.genetic_context: aacC1 – orfA – orfB – aadA1 gene cassette array
aadA1.evidence_note: The presence of aadA1 gene cassette was associated with resistance to multiple antibiotics.

aacC1.genetic_context: aacC1 – orfA – orfB – aadA1 gene cassette array
aacC1.evidence_note: The presence of aacC1 was associated with resistance to gentamicin and tobramycin.

dfrA12.evidence_note: The presence of dfrA12 gene cassette was identified in class 1 integrons.

aadA2.evidence_note: The gene cassette array aadA2 was identified in the variable regions of class 1 integrons.

full_output.key_findings: Class 1 integrons were prevalent in clinical Acinetobacter calcoaceticus-baumannii complex isolates, carrying gene cassettes encoding resistance to aminoglycosides (aadA1, aacC1, aadA2) and trimethoprim (dfrA12). These integrons were associated with multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antibiotic susceptibility testing were used to analyze integrons and resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Exosomes from drug-resistant breast cancer cells transmit chemoresistance by a horizontal transfer of microRNAs.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that exosomes from drug-resistant breast cancer cells can transfer chemoresistance to sensitive cells through the horizontal transfer of microRNAs, particularly miR-222, which targets PTEN and contributes to drug resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study used exosome isolation, miRNA profiling, qRT-PCR, and functional assays to demonstrate the role of exosomal miRNAs in transmitting chemoresistance.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis of ciprofloxacin-conjugated poly (L-lactic acid) polymer for nanofiber fabrication and antibacterial evaluation.
full_output.key_findings: The study focuses on the synthesis of ciprofloxacin-conjugated poly (L-lactic acid) (PLA-CP) for nanofiber fabrication and evaluates its antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus. The research demonstrates that the PLA-CP nanofiber mat effectively releases ciprofloxacin, showing potent antimicrobial activity.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis of PLA-CP through chemical conjugation of ciprofloxacin with PLA, followed by electrospinning to fabricate nanofiber mats. Antimicrobial activity was assessed using agar diffusion and broth dilution methods.

full_output.paper_title: Successful control of a neonatal outbreak caused mainly by ST20 multidrug-resistant SHV-5-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae, Greece.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports on an outbreak of multidrug-resistant SHV-5-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae (ST20) in a neonatal intensive care unit in Greece. SHV-5 and TEM-1 beta-lactamases were identified as the primary mechanisms of resistance.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR, isoelectric focusing, and molecular typing techniques were used to characterize the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Phenotypic resistance and the dynamics of bacterial escape from phage control.
full_output.key_findings: The study explores phenotypic resistance in bacteria, focusing on how variations in adsorption rates can lead to partial resistance to phages without genetic mutations.
full_output.methodology: The research uses mathematical models and empirical experiments to analyze bacterial responses to phage infections.

full_output.paper_title: First evaluation of drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis clinical isolates from Congo revealed misdetection of fluoroquinolone resistance by line probe assay due to a double substitution T80A-A90G in GyrA.

gyrA.notes: The double substitution T80A-A90G in GyrA was found to confer hypersusceptibility to fluoroquinolones.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified a double substitution T80A-A90G in GyrA that leads to hypersusceptibility to fluoroquinolones, causing false resistance detection by line probe assay.
full_output.methodology: DNA sequencing and line probe assays were used to detect mutations in drug target genes.

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the structure of the AcrAB-TolC multidrug efflux pump, highlighting its role in conferring resistance to a broad spectrum of antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Structural biology techniques including X-ray crystallography, cryo-electron microscopy, and biochemical assays were used to analyze the AcrAB-TolC efflux pump.

full_output.paper_title: Occupational exposure to Staphylococcus aureus and Enterococcus spp. among spray irrigation workers using reclaimed water.
full_output.key_findings: The study found no MRSA or VRE in any samples, but detected MSSA in 26% of spray irrigation workers and 29% of controls, and VSE in 11% of spray irrigation workers and 0% of controls. MSSA isolates showed resistance to various antibiotics, including erythromycin, linezolid, tetracycline, and ampicillin.
full_output.methodology: Nasal and dermal swabs were collected and analyzed for MRSA, MSSA, VRE, and VSE using biochemical tests and PCR. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using the Sensititre® microbroth dilution system.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified differentially expressed genes in Listeria monocytogenes 08-5923 exposed to a sublethal dose of carnocyclin A (CCLA), including genes involved in cell division, cell wall synthesis, motility, and metabolism. The downregulation of genes related to the mannose- and cellobiose-specific phosphotransferase systems (PTS) was noted, suggesting their involvement in CCLA resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized microarray, qRT-PCR, SDS-PAGE, and mass spectrometry to analyze gene expression, protein production, and morphological changes in L. monocytogenes following CCLA exposure.

full_output.paper_title: Growth inhibitory, bactericidal, and morphostructural effects of dehydrocostus lactone from Magnolia sieboldii Leaves on antibiotic-susceptible and -resistant strains of Helicobacter pylori.
full_output.key_findings: Dehydrocostus lactone (DCL) from Magnolia sieboldii leaves exhibits growth inhibitory and bactericidal activity against both antibiotic-susceptible and -resistant strains of Helicobacter pylori, with no evidence of resistance development.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial activity of DCL was assessed using broth dilution assays, paper-disk diffusion bioassays, and scanning electron microscopy.

full_output.paper_title: Investigation of antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli and enterococci isolated from Tibetan pigs.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that E. coli and Enterococcus isolates from free-ranging Tibetan pigs showed lower resistance rates to most antibiotics compared to those from intensively farmed animals. High resistance rates were observed for tetracycline, oxacillin, clindamycin, and erythromycin in Enterococcus isolates.
full_output.methodology: Disk diffusion and broth microdilution methods were used to determine antimicrobial resistance.

full_output.paper_title: RalR (a DNase) and RalA (a small RNA) form a type I toxin-antitoxin system in Escherichia coli.

ralR.validation_method: growth inhibition and DNA cleavage assay

ralA.validation_method: toxicity reduction and RNA binding assay

full_output.key_findings: RalR is a proteic toxin with endonuclease activity, and RalA is a small RNA antitoxin that forms a type I toxin-antitoxin system in Escherichia coli.
full_output.methodology: Genetic manipulation, DNA cleavage assay, RNA binding assay, and qRT-PCR.

full_output.paper_title: Shigella spp. with reduced azithromycin susceptibility, Quebec, Canada, 2012-2013.

mph(A).validation_method: PCR detection of the gene and correlation with azithromycin MICs

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the mph(A) gene as responsible for reduced azithromycin susceptibility in Shigella spp. isolates from Montreal, Canada, during 2012-2013.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of the mph(A) gene and susceptibility testing using Etest and Vitek 2.

full_output.paper_title: Extended-spectrum β-lactamases in Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae in Gulls, Alaska, USA.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of extended-spectrum β-lactamases (ESBLs) in Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates from gulls in Alaska, including bla CTX-M, bla SHV, and bla TEM genes.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and MLST analysis were used to identify ESBL genes and determine sequence types of isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Extensively drug-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae, South Korea, 2011-2012.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified five extensively drug-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates carrying the erm(B) gene, which confers resistance to macrolides such as erythromycin and clarithromycin.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR for resistance genes, and molecular typing techniques.

full_output.paper_title: Persistence and complex evolution of fluoroquinolone-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae clone.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in gyrA, parC, and parE genes that confer fluoroquinolone resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae.
full_output.methodology: Sequencing of quinolone resistance-determining regions (QRDR) of genes encoding subunits of topoisomerase IV and DNA gyrase.

full_output.paper_title: Staphylococcus aureus carrying mecC gene in animals and urban wastewater, Spain.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the mecC gene in Staphylococcus aureus isolates from animals and urban wastewater in Spain, highlighting its potential as an environmental reservoir.
full_output.methodology: PCR-based detection of mecC, susceptibility testing, and molecular typing techniques.

full_output.paper_title: Linezolid-Resistant Staphylococcus epidermidis, Portugal, 2012.

rplC.notes: Mutations in L3 ribosomal protein were linked to linezolid resistance
rplC.evidence_note: Mutations in this protein were linked to linezolid resistance, although definitive conclusions are not available

full_output.paper_title: Transcriptional responses to sub-inhibitory concentrations of fosmidomycin in Salmonella typhimurium
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies genes involved in the oxidative stress response in Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium following sub-inhibitory exposure to fosmidomycin, including soxS, sodA, and ahpF.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis using cDNA microarrays and quantitative RT-PCR to examine gene expression changes in response to fosmidomycin exposure.

full_output.paper_title: Hygromycin B and apramycin antibiotic resistance cassettes for use in Campylobacter jejuni.

aph(7\").mechanism: phosphorylation at the 7″-OH of the destomic acid ring
aph(7\").evidence_note: The aph(7") gene confers resistance to hygromycin B by phosphorylating the antibiotic.

aac(3)IV.mechanism: aac (3)IV encodes an aminoglycoside 3-N-acetyltransferase that confers resistance to apramycin by acetylating the 3-amino group of apramycin's deoxystreptamine ring.
aac(3)IV.genetic_context: aac (3)IV is part of a non-polar mutagenesis construct that does not include a promoter or transcription terminator, with the resistance gene preceded by translational stop codons and including a Shine-Dalgarno sequence or ribosome binding site.
aac(3)IV.evidence_note: The paper describes the use of aac (3)IV in plasmids pAC1A and pRRA for conferring apramycin resistance in C. jejuni.

full_output.key_findings: The study developed hygromycin B and apramycin resistance cassettes for use in Campylobacter jejuni, enabling gene deletion, replacement, and expression studies. The aph(7") gene confers resistance to hygromycin B, while aac(3)IV confers resistance to apramycin.
full_output.methodology: Plasmid construction, transformation, and growth analysis were used to validate the resistance cassettes.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of clinical Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium isolates with concurrent resistance to ciprofloxacin, ceftriaxone, and azithromycin.

blaCTX-M-27.evidence_note: blaCTX-M-27 was detected in S. Typhimurium isolates and contributes to ceftriaxone resistance.

blaCTX-M-28.evidence_note: blaCTX-M-28 was detected in S. Typhimurium isolates and contributes to ceftriaxone resistance.

blaCTX-M-79.evidence_note: blaCTX-M-79 was detected in S. Typhimurium isolates and contributes to ceftriaxone resistance.

blaCTX-M-104.evidence_note: blaCTX-M-104 was detected in S. Typhimurium isolates and contributes to ceftriaxone resistance.

blaCMY-2.evidence_note: blaCMY-2 was detected in S. Typhimurium isolates and contributes to ceftriaxone resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the emergence of highly drug-resistant (XDR) Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium isolates with resistance to ciprofloxacin, ceftriaxone, and azithromycin, driven by extended-spectrum beta-lactamases (ESBLs) and the oqxAB efflux pump.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, conjugation experiments, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: IncH-type plasmid harboring bla CTX-M-15, bla DHA-1, and qnrB4 genes recovered from animal isolates.

qnrB4.mechanism: reduction of quinolone binding to DNA gyrase

full_output.key_findings: The study identified an IncH-type plasmid carrying the blaCTX-M-15, blaDHA-1, and qnrB4 genes in animal-derived Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, highlighting the potential for horizontal gene transfer of these resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and susceptibility testing were used to characterize the plasmid and its resistance genes.

full_output.key_findings: The study highlights high error rates in Vitek 2 testing for cefepime susceptibility in extended-spectrum-beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing Escherichia coli, indicating potential unreliability of this method for clinical decision-making.
full_output.methodology: The study compared Vitek 2 results with agar dilution methods for cefepime susceptibility testing in ESBL-producing E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: The mecA Homolog mecC Confers Resistance against β-Lactams in Staphylococcus aureus Irrespective of the Genetic Strain Background.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that the mecC gene, a homolog of mecA, confers resistance to β-lactam antibiotics, specifically oxacillin and cefoxitin, in Staphylococcus aureus, regardless of the genetic strain background.
full_output.methodology: Cloning, mutagenesis, and MIC testing were used to validate the role of mecC in β-lactam resistance.

full_output.paper_title: IS1R-mediated plasticity of IncL/M plasmids leads to the insertion of blaOXA-48 into the Escherichia coli Chromosome.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the insertion of the blaOXA-48 gene into the Escherichia coli chromosome via IS1R-mediated plasticity of IncL/M plasmids, leading to the formation of a novel composite transposon Tn6237.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized molecular techniques including PCR, sequencing, plasmid analysis, and bioinformatic analyses to investigate the genetic environment of blaOXA-48.

full_output.paper_title: Characteristics of Escherichia coli sequence type 131 isolates that produce extended-spectrum β-lactamases: global distribution of the H30-Rx sublineage.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the global distribution of the H30-Rx sublineage of Escherichia coli ST131, highlighting the presence of bla CTX-M-15 and aac(6')-lb-cr genes associated with multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and pulsed-field gel electrophoresis were used to analyze the genetic characteristics of the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Art-175 Is a Highly Efficient Antibacterial against Multidrug-Resistant Strains and Persisters of Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.key_findings: Art-175 is a highly efficient antibacterial that effectively kills multidrug-resistant strains and persisters of Pseudomonas aeruginosa, demonstrating rapid bactericidal activity and resistance to resistance development.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial assays, time-lapse microscopy, and MIC determination were used to evaluate the effectiveness of Art-175.
full_output.sample_size: n=74 and n=79 for Art-085 and Art-175, respectively

full_output.paper_title: Lack of antimicrobial bactericidal activity in Mycobacterium abscessus.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that the chromosomal aac(2')-Id gene in Mycobacterium smegmatis contributes to the lack of aminoglycoside bactericidal activity by acetylating aminoglycosides, thereby reducing their effectiveness. Disruption of this gene restored bactericidal activity.
full_output.methodology: The study used time-kill curve experiments and genetic manipulation of Mycobacterium smegmatis to investigate the role of aac(2')-Id in aminoglycoside resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Potentiation Effects of Amikacin and Fosfomycin against Selected Amikacin-Nonsusceptible Gram-Negative Respiratory Tract Pathogens
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the antimicrobial activities of amikacin and fosfomycin, alone and in a 5:2 combination, against 62 amikacin-nonsusceptible Gram-negative pathogens. The combination showed significant potentiation, reducing the amikacin and fosfomycin MICs required to inhibit the isolates.
full_output.methodology: The study used CLSI reference agar dilution methods to assess the antimicrobial activities of amikacin and fosfomycin against selected Gram-negative pathogens.

full_output.paper_title: Amikacin-fosfomycin at a five-to-two ratio: characterization of mutation rates in microbial strains causing ventilator-associated pneumonia and interactions with commonly used antibiotics.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the mutation rates of amikacin-fosfomycin (5:2) in microbial strains causing ventilator-associated pneumonia and evaluates its interactions with commonly used antibiotics, finding no antagonism and some synergy.
full_output.methodology: The study used in vitro methods including single-step and serial passaging mutational analyses, checkerboard synergy testing, and time-kill assays to evaluate the resistance profiles and interactions of amikacin-fosfomycin (5:2) with various antibiotics.

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the crystal structure of the CmeC outer membrane channel of Campylobacter jejuni, which is part of the CmeABC multidrug efflux pump system.
