full_output.paper_title: Distribution and association of antimicrobial resistance and virulence characteristics in Enterococcus spp. isolates from captive Asian elephants in China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified tet(M), erm(B), and cfr as the most prevalent antimicrobial resistance genes in Enterococcus spp. isolates from captive Asian elephants, highlighting their role in resistance to tetracycline, erythromycin, and chloramphenicol, respectively.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of antimicrobial resistance genes and virulence-associated genes in Enterococcus spp. isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Distribution of ß-Lactamase Genes Among Multidrug-Resistant and Extended-Spectrum ß-Lactamase-Producing Diarrheagenic Escherichia coli from Under-Five Children in Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of bla TEM, bla CTX-M, bla SHV, bla NDM, and bla OXA-48 genes in multidrug-resistant and extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing diarrheagenic Escherichia coli isolates from under-five children in Ethiopia, highlighting the emergence of these resistance genes in the region.

full_output.paper_title: Potency of CRISPR-Cas Antifungals Is Enhanced by Cotargeting DNA Repair and Growth Regulatory Machinery at the Genetic Level.

full_output.paper_title: Formulation, pharmacokinetics, and antibacterial activity of florfenicol-loaded niosome.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies six mutations in the hemagglutinin (HA) and polymerase acidic (PA) proteins of the H9N2 virus that enhance pathogenicity and replication in mice. Specifically, HA-L226Q, T511I, and A528V in HA, and PA-T97I, I545V, and S594G in PA contribute to increased viral replication and pathogenicity. Additionally, mutual antagonism between certain mutations was observed, affecting viral replication dynamics.
full_output.methodology: Serial lung passaging of the H9N2 virus in mice, followed by genetic analysis, viral replication assays, and pathogenicity testing in murine models.

full_output.paper_title: Complex effects of the exo-xis region of the Shiga toxin-converting bacteriophage Φ24(B) genome on the phage development and the Escherichia coli host physiology.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the role of the exo-xis region of the Shiga toxin-converting bacteriophage Φ24 B in phage development and host physiology, revealing its impact on promoting lytic development and modulating host gene expression.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses were used to understand the functions of the exo-xis region.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of the soil resistome and mobilome in Namib Desert soils.

AAC(3')-la.evidence_note: AAC(3')-la (originally detected in clinical strains of P. aeruginosa) encodes acetyltransferases that mediate enzymatic inactivation of aminoglycosides.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified two horizontally acquired antibiotic resistance genes, AAC(3')-la and blaTEM-116, in Namib Desert soils, highlighting the presence of resistance mechanisms against aminoglycosides and beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing and bioinformatics analysis using ResFinder and CARD databases.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial susceptibility of U.S. porcine Brachyspira isolates and genetic diversity of B. hyodysenteriae by multilocus sequence typing.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the antimicrobial susceptibility of U.S. Brachyspira isolates and found varying resistance patterns, with B. hampsonii showing higher susceptibility to tested drugs compared to B. hyodysenteriae and B. pilosicoli. High genetic diversity among B. hyodysenteriae isolates was observed, with 16 different sequence types identified.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was conducted using broth microdilution, and multilocus sequence typing (MLST) was employed to assess genetic diversity.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and identification of caprine pasteurellosis in pneumonic goats in Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified M. haemolytica and P. multocida as the primary causes of caprine pasteurellosis in pneumonic goats in Bangladesh, with high resistance to tetracycline, streptomycin, oxytetracycline, gentamicin, and ceftriaxone.
full_output.methodology: Bacterial isolation, PCR, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were performed.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance patterns of Staphylococcus aureus isolated from apparently healthy pet cats of Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in pet cats and their owners in Bangladesh, highlighting the presence of resistance genes such as mecA, vanC, blaTEM, blaCTX-M, and blaSHV2.
full_output.methodology: PCR and disc diffusion method were used for detecting antimicrobial resistance genes and determining resistance patterns.
full_output.sample_size: 168 pet cat samples and 42 hand swab samples from cat owners

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and characterization of quinolone-resistant Escherichia coli isolated from retail raw beef and poultry meat in Egypt.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified qnrS as a plasmid-mediated quinolone resistance gene in quinolone-resistant E. coli isolates from retail meat in Egypt. Mutations in gyrA (S83L) and parC (S80I) were also found to contribute to quinolone resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize quinolone resistance mechanisms in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Bacannot: A Comprehensive Pipeline for Bacterial Genomics Analysis Including Antimicrobial Resistance and Virulence Gene Annotation

full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, annotation, and analysis using bioinformatics pipelines including Prokka and PlasmidFinder.

full_output.paper_title: Epidemiology and characterization of Providencia stuartii isolated from hospitalized patients in southern Brazil: a possible emerging pathogen.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of bla CTX-M-2, bla CTX-M-9, and bla KPC-2 genes in Providencia stuartii isolates, which confer resistance to multiple antibiotics, including beta-lactams and carbapenems.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of resistance genes and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Yokenella regensburgei urinary tract infection in an immunocompetent patient: a case report.
full_output.key_findings: The case report describes the first instance of Yokenella regensburgei causing a urinary tract infection in an immunocompetent patient, demonstrating resistance to penicillin, amoxicillin, ampicillin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, cefoxitin, and colistin. Whole genome sequencing identified blaYOC-1, arnD, arnT, and pmrD genes associated with beta-lactam and colistin resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and susceptibility testing using Kirby-Bauer disc diffusion methods.

full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the increased prevalence of carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii infections in critically ill COVID-19 patients in an ICU, emphasizing the association with prolonged ICU stays and mechanical ventilation.
full_output.methodology: Cross-sectional study analyzing patients admitted to an ICU with COVID-19, focusing on A. baumannii infections and their clinical correlates.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the emergence of new sequence types ST74 and ST38 of Streptococcus agalactiae in Iran, along with multidrug resistance patterns and specific virulence profiles.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR, MLST, and antibiotic susceptibility testing to analyze S. agalactiae isolates from urinary tract infections.

full_output.paper_title: Impact of contrasting poultry exposures on human, poultry, and wastewater antibiotic resistomes in Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified tetracycline resistance genes (tet(Q)), beta-lactam resistance genes (cfxA6, blaGES-2, blaGES-5), and carbapenem resistance genes in poultry, human fecal, and wastewater samples in Bangladesh, highlighting the enrichment of certain resistance genes in urban poultry and the presence of clinically significant resistance genes in wastewater.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomic sequencing and bioinformatics analysis of ARGs in human, poultry, and wastewater samples.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro and in vivo activity of cefiderocol against Achromobacter spp. and Burkholderia cepacia complex, including carbapenem-non-susceptible isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that cefiderocol exhibited strong in vitro and in vivo activity against Achromobacter spp. and Burkholderia cepacia complex, including carbapenem-non-susceptible isolates. Whole-genome sequencing identified OXA-114, OXA-364, and PenA beta-lactamases as potential resistance mechanisms in some isolates.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the in vitro and in vivo activity of cefiderocol against Achromobacter spp. and Burkholderia cepacia complex isolates using broth microdilution susceptibility testing and animal infection models.
full_output.sample_size: 334 Achromobacter spp. isolates and 425 Bcc isolates

full_output.paper_title: Plasmid genomic epidemiology of bla(KPC) carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales in Canada, 2010-2021.

full_output.methodology: Time-lapse microscopy, NPN and DiSC 3-5 fluorescence assays, MIC/MBC determinations, and protein stability analyses.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance Laboratory Network’s multisite evaluation of the ThermoFisher Sensititre GN7F broth microdilution panel for antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the Sensititre GN7F broth microdilution panel for antimicrobial susceptibility testing, focusing on the impact of different inoculum transfer volumes on the accuracy of resistance detection for various Gram-negative bacteria. It highlighted the importance of using higher transfer volumes to improve essential agreement and reduce major and very major errors.
full_output.methodology: The study used a multisite evaluation of the Sensititre GN7F panel with 100 well-characterized isolates from the CDC & FDA AR Isolate Bank, testing different inoculum transfer volumes and analyzing essential agreement, categorical agreement, major errors, and very major errors.

full_output.paper_title: Developing 3-(2-Isocyano-6-methylbenzyl)-1H-indole Derivatives to Enhance the Susceptibility of Serratia marcescens by Occluding Quorum Sensing.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that IMBI reduces the expression of QS and biofilm-related genes in S. marcescens, enhancing the susceptibility of biofilms to antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: qRT-PCR, molecular docking, and biofilm assays were used to evaluate the effects of IMBI on gene expression and biofilm formation.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug-resistant Corynebacterium diphtheriae in people with travel history from West Africa to France, March to September 2023.

pbp2m.validation_method: genomic sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing

The macrolide-resistance gene ermX was found in the three macrolide-resistant isolates (travel from Guinea, Mali and Niger), always co-located with pbp2m . full_output.paper_title: Decoding the genetic structure of conjugative plasmids in international clones of Klebsiella pneumoniae: A deep dive into blaKPC, blaNDM, blaOXA-48, and blaGES genes.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the genetic structure of plasmids harboring major carbapenemase genes (blaKPC, blaNDM, blaOXA-48, and blaGES) in Klebsiella pneumoniae, identifying the most prevalent allele types and their co-occurrence with other resistance genes.
full_output.methodology: Bioinformatics analysis of plasmid sequences from the GenBank database, including allele type determination, detection of other AMR genes, and genetic evaluation of plasmid characteristics.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic insights into the adaptation of Acinetobacter johnsonii RB2-047 to the heavy metal-contaminated subsurface mine environment.

full_output.paper_title: Mitoribosomal synthetic lethality overcomes multidrug resistance in MYC-driven neuroblastoma.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mitochondrial translation inhibition as a novel therapeutic strategy for overcoming multidrug resistance in MYC-driven neuroblastoma, demonstrating that doxycycline effectively targets mitochondrial ribosomes, leading to the downregulation of MYC proteins and induction of cell death.
full_output.methodology: The study used mitochondrial inhibitors, western blotting, MTT assays, and flow cytometry to analyze the effects of doxycycline on neuroblastoma cells.

full_output.paper_title: A cleavable chimeric peptide with targeting and killing domains enhances LPS neutralization and antibacterial properties against multi-drug resistant E. coli.
full_output.key_findings: The cleavable chimeric peptide R7 showed enhanced antibacterial activity and LPS neutralization against multidrug-resistant E. coli compared to its parental peptides LBP14 and L7.

full_output.paper_title: Glutamine metabolism inhibition has dual immunomodulatory and antibacterial activities against Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: JHU083 exhibits direct antibacterial activity against Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) and enhances host immune responses, reducing bacterial burden and improving survival in murine TB models.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance Genes in Staphylococcus Species Isolated from Diabetic Foot Ulcers and Healthy Skin
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various antimicrobial resistance genes in Staphylococcus species isolated from diabetic foot ulcers and healthy skin, highlighting the prevalence of resistance to beta-lactams, aminoglycosides, macrolides, tetracyclines, fusidic acid, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, fosfomycin, kanamycin, neomycin, and quaternary ammonium compounds.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and PCR-based detection of antimicrobial resistance genes in Staphylococcus species.

full_output.paper_title: Rocket-miR, a translational launchpad for miRNA-based antimicrobial drug development.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents Rocket-miR, a web application that predicts human miRNA targets in bacterial and fungal pathogens, focusing on miRNAs like let-7b-5p and miR-877-5p that target biofilm formation and β-lactam resistance pathways in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and miR-1913-3p that targets the T6SS in Bacteroides fragilis.
full_output.methodology: Bioinformatic predictions using IntaRNA algorithm and experimental validation of miRNA effects on microbial growth and biofilm formation.

full_output.paper_title: The Acinetobacter baumannii K70 and K9 capsular polysaccharides consist of related K-units linked by the same Wzy polymerase and cleaved by the same phage depolymerases.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the K70 capsular polysaccharide (CPS) of the extensively antibiotic-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii isolate SGH0807, identifies the KL70 gene cluster, and reports the presence of several antibiotic resistance genes including catA1, sul1, tetA(A), aadA1, aacC1, and blaTEM-1D.
full_output.methodology: The study used genomic sequencing, NMR spectroscopy, and biochemical analysis to characterize the K70 CPS and identify resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro pharmacodynamics of nemonoxacin and other antimicrobial agents against Mycoplasma pneumoniae.
full_output.key_findings: The study assessed the in vitro pharmacodynamics of nemonoxacin and other antimicrobial agents against Mycoplasma pneumoniae, demonstrating that nemonoxacin exhibited significant mycoplasmacidal activity against both macrolide-susceptible and resistant strains.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized static time-kill curves and pharmacodynamic analysis using the sigmoid E max model to evaluate the antimicrobial effects of nemonoxacin and other agents against Mycoplasma pneumoniae.

full_output.paper_title: Oligoagars and microbial agents show potential for Porphyra disease prevention.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that oligoagars (OA) and microbial agents (MA) improve the resistance of Porphyra conchocelis to the pathogenic bacterium Vibrio mediterranei 117-T6, with survival rates of 70% (OA) and 80% (MA), compared to 15% in the control group.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomics analysis of phycosphere microorganisms and infection experiments with Vibrio mediterranei 117-T6.

full_output.paper_title: Pangenome diversification and resistance gene characterization in Salmonella Typhi prioritized RfaJ as a significant therapeutic marker.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various antibiotic resistance genes in Salmonella Typhi, including efflux pumps, beta-lactamases, and genes involved in target modification, contributing to resistance against multiple antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: The study used pangenome analysis and resistome analysis to identify and characterize antibiotic resistance genes in 119 Salmonella Typhi strains.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characterization of Escherichia coli producing extended-spectrum β-lactamase CTX-M-14 and CTX-M-28 in Mexico.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies blaCTX-M-14 and blaCTX-M-28 as significant contributors to extended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL) production in E. coli isolates from Mexican hospitals, highlighting their resistance to multiple β-lactam antibiotics.

full_output.paper_title: Sub-inhibitory concentrations of ceftriaxone induce morphological alterations and PIA-independent biofilm formation in Staphylococcus aureus.

The study found that ceftriaxone at sub-MIC levels significantly upregulated the expression of biofilm-related genes such as atl, sarA, icaR, and fnbA, leading to increased biofilm formation.
full_output.methodology: The study used qPCR to analyze the expression of biofilm-related genes and crystal violet staining to quantify biofilm formation in S. aureus strains exposed to sub-MIC concentrations of antibiotics.

full_output.paper_title: Biofilm heterogeneity-adaptive photoredox catalysis enables red light-triggered nitric oxide release for combating drug-resistant infections.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies genes involved in multidrug resistance and biofilm formation in ciprofloxacin-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa, demonstrating the effectiveness of red light-triggered nitric oxide release in disrupting biofilms and reducing antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: The research utilized RNA sequencing to analyze gene expression changes in response to NO release from micellar nanoparticles, along with in vitro and in vivo evaluations of antibiofilm activity.

full_output.paper_title: Investigation of antimicrobial susceptibility and genetic diversity among Staphylococcus pseudintermedius isolated from dogs in Rio de Janeiro.

full_output.paper_title: Design and evaluation of tadpole-like conformational antimicrobial peptides.

full_output.key_findings: The paper reviews the resistance mechanisms of β-lactams, macrolides, and fluoroquinolones in Streptococcus pneumoniae, highlighting mutations in penicillin-binding proteins (pbp2x, pbp2b, pbp1a) leading to β-lactam resistance, the role of ermB in macrolide resistance through ribosomal methylation, and the contribution of mefE and mel efflux pumps. It also identifies mutations in gyrA and parC as key determinants of fluoroquinolone resistance.
full_output.methodology: Review of experimental studies and literature on resistance mechanisms in Streptococcus pneumoniae.

full_output.paper_title: Comparative Analysis of Antibiotic Resistance in Acute Cholangitis Patients with Stent Placement and Sphincterotomy Interventions.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified significant variations in multidrug resistance patterns among acute cholangitis patients based on their intervention histories, with a notable prevalence of ESBL, VRE, and CRE in patients who had undergone both sphincterotomy and stent placement.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of 488 bile samples from patients with acute cholangitis, assessing antibiotic resistance patterns using VITEK 2 apparatus and comparing resistance rates across different intervention groups.

full_output.paper_title: Novel Derivatives of Quinoxaline-2-carboxylic Acid 1,4-Dioxides as Antimycobacterial Agents: Mechanistic Studies and Therapeutic Potential.

full_output.methodology: Reverse genetics and genomic analysis were used to validate the role of specific genes in resistance to quinoxaline 1,4-dioxides.

full_output.paper_title: Taxifolin as a Metallo-β-Lactamase Inhibitor in Combination with Augmentin against Verona Imipenemase 2 Expressing Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies taxifolin as a potential metallo-β-lactamase inhibitor effective in combination with Augmentin against VIM-2 expressing Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.methodology: Computational modeling, biochemical assays, and in vivo experiments were conducted to evaluate the inhibitory effects of quercetin analogs, including taxifolin, against VIM-2 metallo-β-lactamase.

full_output.paper_title: Determination of Antimicrobial Resistance and the Impact of Imipenem + Cilastatin Synergy with Tetracycline in Pseudomonas aeruginosa Isolates from Sepsis.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance and Virulence Surveillance in Escherichia coli Isolated from Commercial Meat Samples: A One Health Approach.

full_output.methodology: Molecular identification of resistance and virulence genes, antibiotic susceptibility testing, and biofilm formation assessment.

full_output.paper_title: Two-Dose Ceftiofur Treatment Increases Cephamycinase Gene Quantities and Fecal Microbiome Diversity in Dairy Cows Diagnosed with Metritis.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that two-dose ceftiofur treatment increased the quantities of cephamycinase genes (bla CMY-2) in the fecal microbiota of dairy cows with metritis, while other resistance genes (bla CTX-M, mphA, and qnrB19) did not show significant changes.
full_output.methodology: Quantitative real-time PCR and 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing were used to analyze the fecal microbiota and resistance gene quantities in dairy cows.

full_output.methodology: Phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing and genotypic detection of AMR genes via PCR.

full_output.paper_title: Aquiluscidin, a Cathelicidin from Crotalus aquilus, and the Vcn-23 Derivative Peptide, Have Anti-Microbial Activity against Gram-Negative and Gram-Positive Bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies Aquiluscidin, a cathelicidin-like peptide from Crotalus aquilus, and its derivative Vcn-23, which show potent antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. Both peptides exhibit low cytotoxicity and hemolytic activity, suggesting their potential as novel antimicrobial agents.

full_output.key_findings: The study reveals that farnesol influences fluconazole resistance in Trichosporon asahii by modulating membrane lipid metabolism and efflux pump activity, with distinct mechanisms in sensitive and resistant strains.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses were performed to investigate the effects of farnesol on fluconazole resistance mechanisms in T. asahii.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Potency and E. coli β-Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibition Efficacy of Phenazone-Based Molecules.

full_output.key_findings: The review discusses the EvgS/EvgA two-component system in Escherichia coli, highlighting its role in conferring acid and multidrug resistance, as well as its involvement in bacterial adaptation to environmental stresses. full_output.methodology: The paper reviews existing literature and experimental findings on the EvgS/EvgA system, analyzing its structure, function, and role in bacterial resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiogram of uropathogens and associated risk factors among asymptomatic female college students in Dessie town, Northeast Ethiopia.

full_output.paper_title: Structure-Interaction Relationship of Polymyxins with Lung Surfactant.

full_output.paper_title: α-Aminophosphonate inhibitors of metallo-β-lactamases NDM-1 and VIM-2.

full_output.paper_title: Distribution of chlorhexidine resistance genes among Staphylococcus aureus clinical isolates: the challenge of antiseptic resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Pediatric intensive care unit treatment alters the diversity and composition of the gut microbiota and antimicrobial resistance gene expression in critically ill children.
full_output.key_findings: Short-term PICU treatment in critically ill children led to significant changes in the gut microbiota, including a decrease in bacterial richness and an increase in the relative abundance of certain taxa. full_output.methodology: Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) was used to analyze the gut microbiota and antimicrobial resistance gene expression in critically ill children before and after PICU treatment.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the interactive effects of various anti-hyperglycaemic and anti-hypertensive drugs on the inhibitory and bactericidal activities of first-line anti-TB drugs against M. tuberculosis, revealing that some drugs had additive or synergistic effects while others had adverse effects on the activity of Ethambutol.
full_output.methodology: In vitro and ex vivo experiments were conducted to assess the inhibitory and bactericidal activities of anti-TB drugs in combination with anti-hyperglycaemic and anti-hypertensive drugs.

full_output.paper_title: Phytochemical analysis, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities of Jordanian Pomegranate peels.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the antimicrobial activities of various pomegranate peel extracts, with the ethanol extract showing the highest antimicrobial activity against Micrococcus luteus and the methanol extract showing the highest activity against Salmonella typhi.
full_output.methodology: The study conducted phytochemical screening, antioxidant activity assays (DPPH, ABTS+, FRAP), and antimicrobial activity tests using agar diffusion and broth microdilution assays.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of antibiotic resistance in Helicobacter pylori, particularly to metronidazole (43.2%), levofloxacin (33.9%), and clarithromycin (24%). Multidrug-resistant strains were significantly more common following treatment failure.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study analyzing antimicrobial susceptibility testing data from 192 H. pylori strains.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug-resistant and carbapenemase-producing critical gram-negative bacteria isolated from the intensive care unit environment in Amhara region, Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug-resistant (MDR) and carbapenemase-producing critical Gram-negative bacteria (GNB) in ICU environments, with K. pneumoniae being the most prevalent isolate. Carbapenemase production was highest in K. pneumoniae, followed by P. aeruginosa and E. coli.
full_output.methodology: Environmental samples were collected from ICU surfaces and tested for bacterial isolation and antibiotic susceptibility. Carbapenemase production was phenotypically detected using modified and simplified carbapenem inactivation methods.

full_output.paper_title: Limitations in predicting reduced susceptibility to third generation cephalosporins in Escherichia coli based on whole genome sequence data.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various beta-lactamase genes, including bla CTX-M, bla SHV, bla CMY, bla DHA, bla TEM, and bla OXA, which confer resistance to third-generation cephalosporins in Escherichia coli isolates.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and read mapping techniques were used to identify and characterize beta-lactamase genes in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Mobilization of the bla(KPC-14) gene among heterogenous plasmids in extensively drug-resistant hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the bla(KPC-14) gene as a significant contributor to ceftazidime/avibactam, meropenem, and ertapenem resistance in extensively drug-resistant hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae. The gene was found on non-conjugative IncFII/IncR plasmids and could be transferred to E. coli through conjugation experiments.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, conjugation experiments, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize the resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Adaptive laboratory evolution of Salmonella enterica in acid stress.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in phoQ and phoP genes in Salmonella enterica serovar Enteritidis after adaptive laboratory evolution in acetic acid, which may contribute to increased acid resistance and cross-resistance to antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) was used to select for acid-resistant Salmonella enterica strains, followed by whole-genome sequencing to identify genetic mutations.

full_output.paper_title: The secondary metabolite hydrogen cyanide protects Pseudomonas aeruginosa against sodium hypochlorite-induced oxidative stress.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies hydrogen cyanide (HCN) as a protective factor against sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl)-induced oxidative stress in Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Genes hcnA, hcnB, and hcnC are involved in HCN production and contribute to NaOCl resistance.
full_output.methodology: Transposon mutant library screening, growth analysis, complementation experiments, and HCN detection assays.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic characterization of a multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica serovar Agona isolated from a dietary supplement in Germany.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies 23 antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in a multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica serovar Agona isolate from a dietary supplement in Germany, conferring resistance to 12 different antibiotic classes. Key genes include blaSHV-12, aac(3)-Iig, aac(6')-Iic, aadA2, aph(3')-Ia, aph(3'')-Ib, aph(6)-Id, dfrA19, qacEΔ1, ere(A), sul1, sul2, tet(D), mcr-9.1, catA2, arr, qnrS1, blaTEM-1, aac(3)-IIe, and floR.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to characterize the resistance genes and plasmids in the isolate.

full_output.paper_title: Development of an antimicrobial resistance plasmid transfer gene database for enteric bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents a comprehensive plasmid transfer gene database for enteric bacteria, focusing on the identification and characterization of transfer genes associated with various plasmid types. The database includes 337 genes across 12 different plasmid groups, facilitating the analysis of plasmid transfer mechanisms and their role in the dissemination of antimicrobial resistance.
full_output.methodology: The database was constructed by analyzing plasmid sequences from GenBank, identifying transfer genes through bioinformatics tools, and validating their presence using BLAST-based comparisons and phylogenetic analyses.

full_output.paper_title: Serratia marcescens enzyme SME-2 isolated from sputum in New Zealand.

blaSME-2.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and phenotypic testing

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first isolation of SME-2-producing S. marcescens in New Zealand, highlighting its resistance to carbapenems and the presence of additional resistance mechanisms such as aac(6')-Ic.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and molecular detection methods were used to identify and characterize the resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Riboflavin-Vancomycin Conjugate Enables Simultaneous Antibiotic Photo-Release and Photodynamic Killing against Resistant Gram-Positive Pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents a riboflavin-vancomycin conjugate (VanB2) that combines antibiotic photo-release and photodynamic therapy to effectively kill drug-resistant Gram-positive bacteria, including MRSA and VRE, without significant off-target effects.
full_output.methodology: The research involved chemical synthesis, photophysical characterization, and antimicrobial efficacy testing of the VanB2 conjugate against various Gram-positive bacterial strains.

full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed 469 Group A Streptococcus (GAS) isolates from Auckland, New Zealand, revealing a diverse population with 65 sequence clusters and 49 emm-types. Antimicrobial resistance was rare, with tetM being the most common resistance determinant. The findings highlight the complexity of GAS strain diversity and its implications for vaccine development and disease control.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to characterize GAS isolates, identify emm-types, and assess antimicrobial resistance and virulence factors.

full_output.paper_title: Increased fecal ethanol and enriched ethanol-producing gut bacteria Limosilactobacillus fermentum, Enterocloster bolteae, Mediterraneibacter gnavus and Streptococcus mutans in nonalcoholic steatohepatitis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies four ethanol-producing gut bacteria, Limosilactobacillus fermentum, Enterocloster bolteae, Mediterraneibacter gnavus, and Streptococcus mutans, that are enriched in nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) patients.
full_output.methodology: The study uses culturomics and V3V4 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing to analyze fecal samples from NASH patients and healthy controls.

full_output.paper_title: Exploring clonality and virulence gene associations in bloodstream infections using whole-genome sequencing and clinical data.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes, including fosA, oqxA, and emrD, which were prevalent in Enterobacterales and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. These genes contribute to resistance against fosfomycin, quinolones, and multiple antibiotics, respectively.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify AMR genes and their associations with resistance profiles in bloodstream infection pathogens.

full_output.paper_title: High oral carriage of multidrug resistant Gram-negative bacilli in adolescents: the SOPKARD-Junior study.
full_output.key_findings: The study found high oral carriage of multidrug resistant Gram-negative bacilli (MDR-GNB) in healthy adolescents, with 37.4% carrying GNB and 73.5% of those being MDR. ESBL-producing GNB were associated with respiratory infections.
full_output.methodology: Oral swabs were collected and tested for antimicrobial resistance using disk diffusion and molecular methods.

full_output.paper_title: Ceftriaxone Efficacy for Mycobacterium avium Complex Lung Disease in the Hollow Fiber and Translation to Sustained Sputum Culture Conversion in Patients.
full_output.key_findings: Ceftriaxone showed superior efficacy against Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) compared to the standard-of-care (SOC) regimen, achieving sustained sputum culture conversion (SSCC) in patients and killing all 5 clinical MAC strains in the hollow fiber system model. The optimal dose of ceftriaxone was determined to be 2 g once daily, with a pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic susceptibility breakpoint of 64 mg/L.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a hollow fiber system model of intracellular MAC (HFS-MAC) to evaluate ceftriaxone's efficacy, along with Monte Carlo simulations for dose selection and analysis of pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic parameters.

full_output.paper_title: Clinical and molecular characteristics of Klebsiella pneumoniae infection in a tertiary general hospital of Wuhan, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bla KPC-2 as a major carbapenem resistance gene in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, along with virulence genes rmpA, rmpA2, iroN, and iucA. ST11- KPC-2 was responsible for most of the K. pneumoniae infections.
full_output.methodology: PCR assays, MLST, and Galleria mellonella infection model were used to analyze resistance and virulence genes.

full_output.paper_title: Fecal carriage of extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing enterobacterales from hospitals and community settings in Gaza Strip, Palestine.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bla CTX-M, bla TEM, and bla SHV genes as the main contributors to extended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL) production in Enterobacterales in Gaza Strip, with bla CTX-M being the most prevalent.
full_output.methodology: PCR and phenotypic testing for ESBL detection, along with antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: An attacin antimicrobial peptide, Hill_BB_C10074, from Hermetia illucens with anti-Pseudomonas aeruginosa activity.
full_output.key_findings: The attacin antimicrobial peptide Hill_BB_C10074 from Hermetia illucens exhibits potent antimicrobial activity against Pseudomonas aeruginosa, disrupting its outer membrane and showing greater efficacy than polymyxin B.
full_output.methodology: In silico modeling, recombinant protein expression, antimicrobial activity assays, transmission electron microscopy, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that dietary supplementation with Coriandrum sativum extract improved the growth, health, and resistance to Aeromonas veronii in Oreochromis niloticus reared at suboptimal temperatures.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the effects of Coriandrum sativum powder and extract on the growth, health, and resistance of Oreochromis niloticus through experimental feeding trials and various physiological and immunological assessments.

full_output.paper_title: Engraftment of essential functions through multiple fecal microbiota transplants in chronic antibiotic-resistant pouchitis-a case study using metatranscriptomics.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies Faecalibacterium prausnitzii as a key microbe involved in butyrate biosynthesis, which is crucial for gut health and reducing inflammation in pouchitis patients.
full_output.methodology: Metatranscriptome analysis of stool samples from patients and donors to assess microbial activity and gene expression.

full_output.paper_title: Vertebral osteomyelitis caused by Campylobacter jejuni in an immunocompetent patient.

gyrA.notes: Confers resistance to ciprofloxacin.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a point mutation in the gyrA_T86I gene and an oxacillinase blaOXA-461 family class D beta-lactamase as resistance mechanisms in a Campylobacter jejuni isolate causing vertebral osteomyelitis.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic antibiotic susceptibility tests and whole-genome sequencing were used to determine resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: The induced and intrinsic resistance of Escherichia coli to sanguinarine is mediated by AcrB efflux pump.

acrB.validation_method: MIC testing, complementation, and accumulation assays

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the AcrB efflux pump as a key mediator of induced and intrinsic resistance to sanguinarine in E. coli. Mutations in acrR and marR contribute to increased resistance to sanguinarine and other antimicrobials.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, MIC testing, complementation, and accumulation assays were used to validate the role of AcrB and associated mutations in resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Mutation of mltG increases peptidoglycan fragment release, cell size, and antibiotic susceptibility in Neisseria gonorrhoeae.

mltG.notes: The mltG mutation results in increased antibiotic susceptibility.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that mutation of mltG in Neisseria gonorrhoeae increases peptidoglycan fragment release, cell size, and antibiotic susceptibility, particularly to penicillin, ceftriaxone, and vancomycin.
full_output.methodology: The study used genetic mutations, disk diffusion assays, and biochemical analyses to investigate the role of mltG in peptidoglycan metabolism and antibiotic susceptibility.

full_output.paper_title: Functional characterization of two TolC in the resistance to drugs and metals and in the virulence of Riemerella anatipestifer.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies two TolC proteins, TolCA and TolCB, in Riemerella anatipestifer CH-1, with TolCA showing broader resistance to drugs and metals compared to TolCB.
full_output.methodology: Deletion mutant analysis, MIC experiments, disk diffusion assays, ICP-MS, and oxidative stress sensitivity assays.

full_output.paper_title: Clarithromycin overcomes stromal cell-mediated drug resistance against proteasome inhibitors in myeloma cells via autophagy flux blockage leading to high NOXA expression.

NOXA.mechanism: upregulation by ER stress loading and blocking autophagy-mediated degradation

full_output.key_findings: CAM overcomes stromal cell-mediated drug resistance by upregulating NOXA expression, which is crucial for enhanced cytotoxicity of proteasome inhibitors in MM cells.
